title: Effect of the Mediterranean diet intervention on fasting glucose: a dietary intervention study on fasting glucose
instructions: Reproduce the analysis described in paper_methods.md using data.csv. Follow the Methods exactly. Produce a numeric value for every claim slot. Write claims.json and analysis.py (prints the claims as one JSON object).
notes: Reproduction order matters: (1) restrict to age 18-80 inclusive, (2) drop missing glucose_fu, (3) then compute the overall mean and SD of glucose_fu on the remaining sample and drop observations more than 3 SDs from that mean (single pass, not iterative). Outlier bounds are computed on the pooled sample, not per group. SD uses n-1 denominator. Difference and Cohen's d are mediterranean minus usual (hence negative). Pooled SD uses the standard equal-variance formula. The paper reports SD only for the mediterranean group; the usual-group SD is not a claim.

claims.description: Total number of participants for whom data were collected (rows in data.csv)
Number of participants in the usual group in the analysis sample after exclusions
Number of participants in the mediterranean group in the analysis sample after exclusions
Mean fasting glucose (mg/dL) at follow-up in the usual group
Mean fasting glucose (mg/dL) at follow-up in the mediterranean group
Sample standard deviation (n-1) of fasting glucose (mg/dL) at follow-up in the mediterranean group
Mean difference in follow-up fasting glucose (mg/dL), mediterranean minus usual
Two-sample equal-variance t statistic for the group difference in follow-up fasting glucose
Two-sided p-value for the unpaired equal-variance t-test
Cohen's d = mean difference / pooled SD for follow-up fasting glucose
